release_rule: A pair is enabled for screened recipe export only if all three takes pass target accuracy, unchanged root/lower body/contact, inherited baseline acceptance, edit budget and existing loop screens.
scope: Wider-arm cyclic smoothing; three observed development seeds and one newly reserved seed, not broad generalization. Lower ranges unchanged. Upper-body world rotations smoothed by two circular [1/4,1/2,1/4] passes and SO(3) projection before re-fitting angles. No changed quality thresholds, physics or stat mapping.
